text:
hugo.docs: Doing a concise pass on the 'hello-slimline' quickstart. Found three small but confusing items for new users: (1) env var examples only show POSIX `export`, no PowerShell, (2) code snippets still reference `client.generate()` and `res.text`, and (3) one Docker snippet pins SDK v1.
maya.devex: Good catches. Those trips came up in the last onboarding cohort. Can you list the exact snippets/files?
hugo.docs: Sure - quick hits: /quickstart/steps/auth.md (env), /examples/js/usage.md (method + response), /examples/docker/Dockerfile (package pin).
alex.eng: I'll prep a small PR to: a) normalize examples to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and show PowerShell (`$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = '...'`), b) switch generate -> createCompletion and `res.output[0].text`, c) update Dockerfile to `@redwood/inference@^2` and simplify import to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`.
maya.devex: Please also add a one-line migration note under "Quick upgrade notes": "SDK v2: generate -> createCompletion; response structure changed to output array; env var renamed to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" so that search results surface it.
hugo.docs: Also add a tiny TS test snippet showing token injection for unit tests, just a couple lines. New users often ask how to stub the client.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1515 "docs(quickstart): auth + method + docker fixes" by alex.eng
maya.devex: I'll do a wording pass after CI, then merge if green. Can someone run a quick cross-platform smoke on the playground snippets? The copy button has regressed before.
alex.eng: I'll queue a quick playground smoke run once tests pass.
merge-bot: CI: docs build started.
maya.devex: Thanks everyone  once merged I'll update the instructor checklist and drop a one-line note in #help for the onboarding leads.
